items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, I think Doc Cheatham recorded this recently.

ctx.x: Way back when I was 89. That’s my other tune that I heard, that’s the theme song—
Oh, I think Doc Cheatham recorded this recently. “That’s My Home,” yes.
Did he really? Well it’s a pretty tune. Yes it is. Yeah and then another tune on there is “Poor Butterfly,” that’s been my theme song—
